messages:
nora_design: quick find from the QA pass 1  Compact models list: focus ring sometimes lingers when tabbing fast on dark theme.

eli_ui: I can repro. We animate a tiny scale + box-shadow on focus which seems to create a ghosted outline frame.

sam_a11y: repro steps: Console -> Models -> Density: Compact -> tab rapidly. Windows Chrome and mac Safari both show a split-second duplicate ring. Screen readers sometimes re-announce previous row.

eli_ui: temporary fix idea  only apply scale on :hover, and use :focus-visible for keyboard focus with a solid contrast ring. Example:
```css
.row:focus-visible { transform: none; outline: 3px solid var(--focus); }
.row:hover { transform: scale(1.01); }
```

sam_a11y: also check tabindex: some rows have inner badge nodes with tabindex=0 creating duplicate focus stops. Make only the row tabbable.

nora_design: another nit: skip link jumps behind sticky header. Users said the first row is hidden after skipping.

ops_bot: suggestion: set `:target { scroll-margin-top: var(--header-height); }` or `html { scroll-padding-top: var(--header-height); }` so skip lands correctly across breakpoints.

sam_a11y: agree. Also add aria-live to status updates (polite) so SR users hear transitions like "Status: training". Keep assertive only for errors.

eli_ui: I'll draft a small PR: 1) remove focus transforms for keyboard (use :focus-visible), 2) remove tabindex from non-interactive children, 3) add scroll-margin-top on anchors, 4) update badge markup with role=status and aria-live=polite.

nora_design: thanks  please include a small QA script in the PR: tab/shift-tab across 20 rows, trigger status change, and hit skiplink on small viewport. Sam will run NVDA/VoiceOver.

sam_a11y: will review the PR and run SR passes. If double announce persists, we'll capture a repro recording and check paint profiler. :white_check_mark:
